facts.statement: The genus Khoratosuchus was described by Lauprasert and colleagues in 2009.
Khoratosuchus lived in northeast Thailand during the Early Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Khoratosuchus is an extinct genus of neosuchian crocodylomorph which existed in northeast Thailand during the early Cretaceous period.

facts.statement: The skull of Khoratosuchus features secondary choanae positioned relatively posteriorly and a smooth dorsal surface.
facts.quote: including secondary choanae relatively posterior and almost encircled by the pterygoid bones on the palate and a smooth dorsal surface of the skull.

facts.statement: Khoratosuchus is classified as a neosuchian crocodylomorph.
facts.quote: Khoratosuchus is an extinct genus of neosuchian crocodylomorph

facts.statement: Khoratosuchus lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Khoratosuchus is the youngest and most advanced Mesozoic crocodyliform known from Thailand.
rejected.quote: Khoratosuchus is the youngest and most advanced Mesozoic crocodyliform yet known from Thailand.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'is the youngest and most advanced Mesozoic crocodyliform'
